classification.difficultyReason: Development: alongside reading birth height, students reverse the taught interpolation process to find an age from a height and compare heights at ages 7 and 8 to determine annual growth. These are routine linked graph-reading procedures.

content.prompt: The graph shows Lillian’s height over a 10-year period from when she was born.

spec.description: Eleven blue circular observations joined by red segments. Grid extends to age 11 and height 180 without labels on those terminal gridlines. One zero label below the origin.
spec.mathematics: Approximate source-marker coordinates: (0,44), (1,55), (2,70), (3,75), (4,85), (5,95), (6,105), (7,110), (8,124), (9,135), (10,145). These preserve the source curve and are not asserted as an exact dataset. Horizontal interval 1 year; vertical interval 20 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied graph; no answer guides or answer text.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What was Lillian’s height when she was born?

answer.worked: At age 0, the plotted height is just above $40\text{ cm}$, approximately $44\text{ cm}$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: At what age did she first reach 130 cm tall?

answer.short: Between 8 and 9 years old, approximately 8.5 years.
answer.worked: Read across from $130\text{ cm}$ to the red segment, then down to the age axis. The crossing is between ages 8 and 9, approximately 8.5 years.

inlines.text: How much did Lillian grow in the year when

answer.worked: Read the heights at ages 7 and 8 as approximately $110\text{ cm}$ and $124\text{ cm}$. Her growth was approximately $124-110=14\text{ cm}$.
